title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1413: He tu and dummy (2)

section.p: As they traveled, He Tu continued looking around. The more he looked, the more doubtful he felt. These hairs really resembled someone’s hair that was being draped downward.

When they flew higher, he felt as though he was approaching the scalp. But for He Tu, the scalp might as well be the sturdiest of walls. Even with his strength, he couldn’t deal any damage to the wall here.
Left with no choice, he could only continue flying along the wall. Of course, the attacks from the pillars were also growing intense. But as they flew, the pillars started becoming sparse.
And finally, they left the forest of pillars and landed on a massive platform. Or to be precise, they had landed on the upper part of the forehead.
He Tu’s expression turned odd. He looked around and saw numerous large pillars hanging on the side of the platform. For some reason, the pillars were no longer attacking him.
After some hesitation, He Tu looked at his friend, whom he was now calling Dummy, and asked, “You…were you here before? Just what place is this?”
Then, he looked behind him with a frown. Some ripples could be seen in the air. That was a barrier. When he approached the barrier, he could vaguely see through it.

Suddenly, a large amount of death qi converged on his eyes. Then, his eyes shone. With that, he was finally able to see through the barrier. His expression changed. There was something familiar about this.
What did he see?
He saw a seemingly endless mountain range.
“Brow Mountain…”
A name emerged in his mind out of nowhere.
Brow Mountain.
His expression changed drastically.
Brow Mountain!
In that case, where was this?
He looked around with a greatly alarmed expression. He saw the Brow Mountain! The gigantic Brow Mountain!
“Fuck!”
Holy shit!
He had somehow entered the Luminous Domain Mansion! No, this wasn’t right. The Brow Mountain was on the first level. In that case, where was he?
Negative first level?
Basement?
“There is a basement in the Luminous Domain Mansion? No, no, this…place is connected to the Death Realm!”
He Tu’s expression changed drastically. Had he forgotten something?

He was not an expert from the ancient past. Rather, he was a human expert of the first epoch. Additionally, he was also a descendant of an ancient past expert. The bloodline of that ancient expert ran thick in his veins.

He couldn’t remain calm. He had entered the basement of the Luminous Domain Mansion through the Death Realm. What did this signify? This signified that the Luminous Domain Mansion ran through both the Myriad Realms and the Death Realm. That was a terrifying concept.

He also knew that there was actually a death tunnel in the Luminous Domain Mansion as well. However, that tunnel was connected to the seventh level. Furthermore, the situation there was too complicated. It wouldn’t be easy to reach due to the restrictions of the laws.
But the power of the laws…did not extend to this place.
In other words, the tunnel connected to the seventh level was more like a prison. The laws were the jailers. One would only be able to move through it with the permission of the jailers.

Meanwhile, this place seemed to be a backdoor. An unguarded backdoor to the Luminous Domain Mansion. A certain realization hit him. After entering the mansion through this place, would he return to the Death Realm upon leaving? Or would he be transported to the Myriad Realms? It did not matter. He had finally found a place where the heavenly laws did not exist. He could move freely in the Luminous Domain Mansion!
In his shock, he looked at Dummy and asked, “Who are you exactly? Is this a coincidence? Or is this intentional? How can there be tunnels to the Luminous Domain Mansion from the Death Realm?”

Once again, He Tu’s expression changed as he exclaimed, “360 stars. 360 tunnels. This is the same number as the special tunnels! This…yes! The Luminous Domain Mansion has opened recently! In that case, the tunnels in the Death Realm have opened at the same time as the tunnels in the Myriad Realms!”
Numerous thoughts emerged in his mind.
Abruptly, he shouted, “Su Yu!”
He started gnashing his teeth. That was the name of the bastard who had dared to provoke him previously. Was that bastard in the mansion as well? Was that bastard here?
“Su Yu!”
He Tu smiled, revealing his black teeth. Was Su Yu here? He had…somehow entered the Luminous Domain Mansion!
“Hahaha!”
He Tu roared with laughter.
When he was done laughing, he looked at Dummy and said, “Come on. Let’s enter the Luminous Domain Mansion!”

This was the basement of the mansion. This was also the forehead. As for the massive pillars, those were the hair. In fact, a certain idea was starting to emerge in his mind. But that was too scary a possibility. He did not even dare to entertain it.
The Human Face World was not hairless! And the Luminous Domain Mansion was really connected to the Death Realm.

The Human Face World might resemble a human face slightly, but not everyone gave it much thought. Most people believed this was some sort of joke played by the builder. But now that He Tu had seen the hair of the Human Face World, he couldn’t help but think of a certain possibility.

Was this really just a joke? If this was a joke, was there a need to build even the hair? As he walked, he found himself ramming into the barrier instead of phasing through it. He blanked out. Could he not walk through it?
He frowned and sent a palm attack at the barrier. It only caused the barrier to shake slightly.
“It’s impassable?”

No way…right? Soon, he thought of something. One could only enter the Luminous Domain Mansion through specific entrances. This might not be one of those entrances. It didn’t matter. Since he was already in the basement, there was no rush. He could probably find the proper entrance after looking around.
He would be inside before he knew it.
At that thought, He Tu started laughing again. When he looked at Dummy again, he had a satisfied expression. What a good subordinate.
With this, he could finally come into direct contact with the younger generation of the Myriad Realms.
And among them was someone called Su Yu. That guy better be here as well. And that guy better be alive. Wasn’t that guy cocky?
That guy had destroyed his remnant and insulted him before. He Tu had not forgotten about that. Just wait.
And thus, He Tu started his search for a way into the mansion.
Su Yu had naturally not imagined that there would be a basement in the Luminous Domain Mansion.

Through countless years of exploration, it was concluded that there were nine levels in the mansion. Nobody knew that there was a basement. Nobody knew that two Invincible death spirits were currently roaming the basement. One of them was someone with a grudge toward Su Yu.

After defeating He Tu’s remnant previously, Su Yu had rained insults on He Tu, thinking that He Tu would not be able to leave. Thanks to his ignorance, Su Yu was feeling particularly relaxed in the mansion. He was the strongest individual on the first level. This would probably last until the third level. What was there for him to fear?

Thus, he was feeling very relaxed. He couldn’t enter the ninth level, and there was no guarantee that he would enter the eighth level. As for the seventh level, he would decide later. He had plenty of time left. It was only the second day. There was no rush at all.

When it was time to temper his mouth, Su Yu hesitated. If it were any other part of his face, he could either cut or dig it off. But what was he supposed to do with his mouth? Was he supposed to cut it off as well?
But soon, he discovered that there was no need for him to go through that trouble. However, it would be quite disgusting.

Su Yu noted that some astral winds were swirling at the depths of the Heavenly Pit. After a slight test, he found that he only needed to inhale the air there and let the air swirl in his mouth. The air would automatically temper his mouth for him.
It was simple…but…Su Yu couldn’t help but wonder if Old Zhou had bad breath. Were the astral winds here…Old Zhou’s breath? In short, he had to inhale Old Zhou’s breath to temper his mouth.
Fine, fine.
So be it.
If even earwax could be treated as treasures, this was nothing.
Just look at what Xia Huyou and the others were doing. They were sprawled on the ground, inhaling deeply from the ground itself. They were essentially kissing Old Zhou’s tongue.
How disgusting.

Even deeper in the Heavenly Pit, a clear pond could be seen. Su Yu had the urge to gather some of the water from the pond, as it was obvious the water in the pond was incredibly valuable as well. However, he couldn’t bring himself to do it. After collecting Old Zhou’s earwax, and after inhaling Old Zhou’s breath, was he supposed to collect Old Zhou’s saliva as well?
While he was hesitating, Xia Huyou urged him, “Su Yu! Go collect it! This is the Emperor’s Saliva, an absolute treasure renowned throughout the Myriad Realms.

Yellow Nine offered an explanation as well, “This thing is even better than the spring water of the Blood Plain. It has miraculous healing effects. Aren’t you injured? A few drops of the Emperor’s Saliva will probably be enough for you to make a full recovery.”
“I would rather die.”

Su Yu snorted. How could they tell him to consume saliva? To make things worse, this was the saliva of someone who had died countless years ago. No way! Fine, fine. He would gather some. This was still a treasure. At worst, he could sell it. Nobody knew it was saliva anyway.

Then again, the dragon race had a treasure known as the Dragon’s Saliva as well. It was said that this treasure was made from the saliva of dragons. And everyone loved it. Why? Why would they love the saliva of the dragons?

Also, there was a unique delicacy called the bird’s nest. It was also a relatively popular food. If everyone could accept eating the saliva of birds and dragons, they could probably accept Old Zhou’s saliva as well.
Su Yu couldn’t help but wonder if Old Zhou would constantly emanate a refreshing aroma when he was alive.
With such random thoughts in his mind, Su Yu drained the entire pond. Sure enough, the pond contained an incredible amount of energy. And the energy also felt incomparably saintly and pure.
“I’ll look for the smiling mouth lotus on the third level instead. Its roots can be used to recover from physical injuries as well. If I can’t find any…”
